regime_context: US thematic detector as of 2026-06-29 shows Memory, HBM & Storage as the dominant leader (broad participation, no crowding) amid a broad rotation with many eligible themes. The absolute-trend gate is active and has historically reduced drawdowns, but momentum rankings provide no return forecast (rank-IC ~0). The macro backdrop is geopolitics-heavy with high unscheduled news share, adding uncertainty.
emerging_watch: Memory, HBM & Storage: monitor for a sustained rank drop (>2 positions) or an eligibility flip to false within 10 days; such a move would confirm a leadership handoff and nullify the overweight lean. Otherwise, maintain watch.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The theme is the detection leader and eligible under the absolute-trend gate, which historically lowered volatility/drawdown. Broad breadth (1.0) and lack of crowding (z=0.29) support trend continuation, but we do not treat the rank as a return signal. The overweight is conditional on the trend staying intact.
evidence: Eligibility via absolute-trend gate (trend-following risk control)
Durability_bar = 0.75 at eligibility threshold, theme remains above
Not crowded (crowding_z=0.29), reducing risk of sharp reversals
theses.dissent: Mixed Hurst exponent suggests lack of persistent trend; momentum rank has no forward alpha; the macro environment is geopolitically tense with high unscheduled news, which could derail sector narratives.

falsifier.text: If eligibility flips to false OR breadth falls below 0.7 within the next 20 trading days, the overweight thesis is invalid.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
